title: Bishop Springs the Battery
setup: Your rook and bishop are stacked on the e-file — the bishop in front, the rook loaded behind it.
hint: Any bishop move uncovers a rook check. Pick the one that also attacks something Black cannot save.
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop on e6 masks the rook on e4. The moment it moves, the rook checks down the file, so the bishop's move comes with a free threat.

{{Bd5+}} steps off the file and eyes the rook on a8. Black must answer the check, and no black piece can block on e5, e6 or e7. After {{Kd8}}, {{Bxa8}} banks the rook.

A battery's front piece moves with a threat built in, so choose the square where it does double duty.
